### Restoring the Temple
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-may-5-2024.html
Passage: John 2:15, 17
Points:
- Jesus expressed righteous anger because a sacred place meant for prayer had turned into a center for profit.
- His holy zeal confronted the commercial practices that kept people of all nations from truly encountering God.
- When His authority was challenged, Jesus pointed forward to the temple of His body, which would be raised in three days.
- Christ came not only to cleanse physical temple grounds, but to purify human hearts through His death and resurrection.
- Followers of Christ are called to share His uncompromising passion for God's honor and glory.

### The Wrath of God's Son
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/wrath-gods-son
Passage: John 2:15
Points:
- Because Jesus was fully human yet entirely sinless, His temple cleansing demonstrates that righteous anger can exist without sin.
- Merchants set up trade in the court of the Gentiles, hindering non-Jewish seekers from worshiping the Lord.
- Religious traders and money changers exploited traveling worshipers through price-gouging and unfair exchange rates.
- Jesus expelled the merchants to halt the mistreatment of the poor and restore God's house for all worshipers.
- Modern believers must avoid imposing extra-biblical barriers that obstruct others from hearing and receiving the gospel.
